title: SABD - Q3 Distribuzione ritardi per compagnia e fascia (real-time)

targets.query: from(bucket: "flights") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "q3_1d" and r["airline"] == "${airline}" and r["hour"] == "${hour}") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "p25" or r["_field"] == "p50" or r["_field"] == "p75" or r["_field"] == "p90") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"]) |> group(columns: ["_field"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Distribuzione ultima finestra 1g - $airline per fascia oraria

targets.query: base = from(bucket: "flights") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "q3_1d" and r["airline"] == "${airline}") latest = base |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "num_flights") |> group() |> max(column: "_time") |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0) base |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_time"] == latest._time) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "num_flights" or r["_field"] == "delay_min" or r["_field"] == "p25" or r["_field"] == "p50" or r["_field"] == "p75" or r["_field"] == "p90" or r["_field"] == "delay_max") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "hour", "_field", "_value"]) |> group() |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "hour"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> rename(columns: {_time: "ts"}) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with hour: int(v: r.hour) })) |> sort(columns: ["hour"])
